site.name: Corso Italia
site.tagline: Study and live in Italy, step by step
site.description: A free bilingual guide for Arab students who want to study in Italy: universities, scholarships, applications, visa and daily life.
home.hero.title: Your path to studying in Italy
home.hero.text: Clear, free guidance in Arabic and English: from choosing a program to getting your residence permit.

home.sections.opportunities: Workshops, teaching sessions and other opportunities.

engpro.intro: EngPro is a free initiative. Students improve their English with resources and live sessions, and volunteer teachers give their time to help them. Nobody pays and nobody is paid.

engpro.learners.text: Find your level, use free resources and join sessions with volunteer teachers.

engpro.teachers.text: Share your English with students who need it. Sign up, get a short review and start teaching.
